independence: Each workload process has a separate source copy, synthetic SQLite DB, baseline/optimized selection and concurrency pool. Baseline and optimized share the same aggregate stress envelope.
warmup: One initial request then one full batch at the target concurrency before timing; startup/concurrency warm-up included in peak RSS
latency: Measured separately with resources stopped, 2 CPU / 4 GiB.
memory_sampling: Independent 5-second sampler throughout timed run; first and last 5-minute medians. Never inferred from request completion cadence.
diagnostic: Previous request-completion-only RSS sampler missed first 5 minutes for the slowest expanded concurrency workload; interrupted and excluded.
control_result: Expanded concurrency-4 historical baseline completed 1812.79 seconds and 40 successful complete responses, but exceeded the 32 MiB growth threshold (80.28 MiB); original exit 1 retained. All four optimized workloads passed the unchanged delivery budget.
assertion_scope: The delivery RSS-growth budget applies to optimized implementation; historical control results remain measured even when outside it. Only this post-measurement assertion was corrected after collection; requests, timing and raw memory samples are unchanged.

counter_windows.cpu_and_file_yaml_counters: timed interval after initial and concurrency warm-up
counter_windows.sql: includes initialization and concurrency warm-up; reported as raw total, not a timed per-request rate
counter_windows.peak_rss: entire process including initialization and warm-up
